sections.section_content:
Perform each movement as a Tabata (20s work / 10s rest x 8 intervals). Rest 1 minute between movements:

* **Sumo Deadlift High Pull** (45 lb barbell)
* **Squat**
* **Pull-up**
* **Push-up**
* **Sit-up**
section_notes: Score is the total of the minimum reps performed in any of the 8 intervals for each movement.

metadata.raw_content:
Tabata Sumo deadlift high pull, 45 pound barbell  
Rest 1 minute  
Tabata Squat  
Rest 1 minute  
Tabata Pull-up  
Rest 1 minute  
Tabata Push-up  
Rest 1 minute  
Tabata Sit-up  
  
The Tabata interval is 20 seconds of work followed by 10 seconds of rest for 8 intervals.  
Tabata score is the least number of reps performed in any of the eight intervals.  
  
Post Tabata score for each exercise to comments and total for final score.  
E.G., 10, 22, 9, 15, 15 = 71  
  
Compare to [042210](http://www.crossfit.com/mt-archive2/000580.html).

section_notes: Build up to a heavy single for the day.

sections.section_content:
Three rounds of 1-minute stations (no rest between exercises, 1-minute rest between rounds):

* **Wall-ball** (20 lb ball, 10 ft target)
* **Sumo deadlift high-pull** (75 lb)
* **Box Jump** (20 inch box)
* **Push-press** (75 lb)
* **Row** (Calories)
section_notes: Move immediately on the 'rotate' call. Score is total reps/calories across all rounds.

metadata.raw_content:
"**Fight Gone Bad!**"  
  
Three rounds of:  
Wall-ball, 20 pound ball, 10 ft target (Reps)  
Sumo deadlift high-pull, 75 pounds (Reps)  
Box Jump, 20" box (Reps)  
Push-press, 75 pounds (Reps)  
Row (Calories)  
  
In this workout you move from each of five stations after a minute.The clock does not reset or stop between exercises. This is a five-minute round from which a one-minute break is allowed before repeating. On call of "rotate", the athletes must move to next station immediately for best score. One point is given for each rep, except on the rower where each calorie is one point.  
  
Add your points and post them to comments.  
  
Compare to [061219](http://www.crossfit.com/mt-archive2/001579.html).
